[!GOOS:linux] skip 'raw syscall fixtures use the Linux syscall ABI'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd a/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/sysa$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/adep'' reaches ''syscall\.Syscall'''
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_net\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/adep'' reaches ''syscall\.Syscall'''
stderr 'example\.com/adep\.Init\(\) +at [^ ]+\.go:\d+'
stderr 'transitive_exec_allowlist'
stderr 'transitive_net_allowlist'
cd ../..

cd b/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/sysb$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/bdep'' reaches ''syscall\.RawSyscall6'''
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_net\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/bdep'' reaches ''syscall\.RawSyscall6'''
cd ../..

cd c/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/sysc$GOEXE ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities::'
exec $WORK/bin/sysc$GOEXE
stdout '^granted$'
cd ../..

cd d/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/sysd$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_net\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/ddep'' reaches ''syscall\.Syscall6'''
! stderr 'unauthorized_exec'
cd ../..

cd e/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/syse$GOEXE ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities::'
exec $WORK/bin/syse$GOEXE
stdout '^std-ok$'
cd ../..

cd f/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/sysf$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/fdep'' reaches ''golang\.org/x/sys/unix\.Syscall'''
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_net\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/fdep'' reaches ''golang\.org/x/sys/unix\.Syscall'''
! stderr 'Transitive dependency ''golang\.org/x/sys/unix'''
cd ../..

cd g/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/sysg$GOEXE ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities::'
exec $WORK/bin/sysg$GOEXE
stdout '^dead-ok$'
cd ../..

cd h/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/sysh$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'internal/runtime/syscall/linux\.Syscall6'
cd ../..

-- a/main/go.mod --
module example.com/amain

go 1.27

require example.com/adep v0.0.0

replace example.com/adep => ../dep

-- a/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_net = "deny"

-- a/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/adep"

func main() { adep.Init() }

-- a/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/adep

go 1.27

-- a/dep/dep.go --
package adep

import "syscall"

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	syscall.Syscall(syscall.SYS_GETPID, 0, 0, 0)
}

-- e/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/edep

go 1.27

-- e/dep/dep.go --
package edep

import (
	"os"
	"syscall"
)

//go:noinline
func Init() string {
	syscall.Kill(0, 0)
	os.ReadFile("go.mod")
	return "std-ok"
}

-- f/main/go.mod --
module example.com/fmain

	example.com/fdep v0.0.0
	golang.org/x/sys v0.0.0
)

replace example.com/fdep => ../dep

replace golang.org/x/sys => ../sys

-- f/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_exec_allowlist = ["golang.org/x/sys/**"]
transitive_net = "deny"
transitive_net_allowlist = ["golang.org/x/sys/**"]

-- f/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/fdep"

func main() { fdep.Init() }

-- f/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/fdep

go 1.27

require golang.org/x/sys v0.0.0

-- f/dep/dep.go --
package fdep

import (
	"syscall"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
)

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	unix.Syscall(syscall.SYS_GETPID, 0, 0, 0)
}

-- f/sys/go.mod --
module golang.org/x/sys

go 1.27

-- f/sys/unix/unix.go --
package unix

import "syscall"

//go:noinline
func Syscall(trap, a1, a2, a3 uintptr) (r1, r2 uintptr, err syscall.Errno) {
	return syscall.Syscall(trap, a1, a2, a3)
}

-- h/dep/empty.s --
-- h/dep/dep.go --
package hdep

import _ "unsafe"

//go:linkname sys6 internal/runtime/syscall/linux.Syscall6
func sys6(trap, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6 uintptr) (r1, r2, errno uintptr)

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	sys6(39, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
}
